products.name: Monday.com AI
products.note: Work OS AI; project automation; cross-functional data; Israeli data transfer considerations

profile_text.body:
monday.com is a Tel Aviv-based public company (Nasdaq: MNDY) that describes itself as an AI work platform where AI agents work alongside people to execute, manage, and operate work together. The company's site presents a single unified environment intended to serve individuals, small and medium businesses, enterprises, and nonprofits, with additional offerings including a template library, an app marketplace, and around-the-clock support.

The company's primary AI product, tracked here as Monday.com AI, is positioned as a work operating system that combines project automation with cross-functional data access. The site emphasizes that its AI agents are given context before acting, and that the underlying infrastructure is described as enterprise-grade, with built-in data privacy, governance, permissions, and compliance protections. Israeli data transfer considerations are noted in connection with the product.

The held facts show 149 legal exposure items linked to Illinois, which may reflect litigation or regulatory filings in that jurisdiction. monday.com is a for-profit public company with CIK 0001845338 on file, verified as of August 2026, and no MCP server presence is recorded.
